socfpga_sip_handler.h

SDM Mailbox hardware abstraction driver interface for the SoCFPGA bare-metal software stack.

smc_call
int smc_call(
uint64_t 
function_id,
uint64_t 
*
register_val
)

Performs a Secure Monitor Call (SMC) to transition from the current Exception Level (e.g., EL1 or EL2) into the Secure Monitor (EL3), where the Secure Device Manager (SDM) firmware resides.

This function handles the low-level assembly sequence required to load the function ID into the X0 register and register arguments into the X1-X11 registers. It then executes the `smc` instruction and captures the resulting return values from the CPU registers back into the provided memory array.

Parameters
function_id
uint64_t

The unique identifier for the SiP (Silicon-in-Package) service requested (e.g., mailboxes or security services).

register_val
uint64_t*

Pointer to an array of at least SMC_CALL_REG_COUNT (11) uint64_t elements representing X1-X11. On entry, this array populates the call arguments; on return, the array is updated with the values returned by the EL3 monitor. Passing a shorter array is undefined behaviour (stack smash).

Returns

The value contained in the X0 register post-SMC (typically 0 for success, or a specific error status code as defined by the SiP service).
